project_type: Python FastAPI translation platform with React frontend and Docker orchestration
build_system: pip/pyproject.toml for backend, npm/vite for frontend, docker-compose for orchestration
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, httpx AsyncClient for API tests (tests/ directory)
build_command: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (frontend); pip install -e '.[dev]' (backend)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest tests/ to verify backend tests pass. 2. cd frontend && npm run build to verify frontend compiles. 3. docker compose config to validate docker-compose.yml syntax.
setup_instructions: pip install -e '.[dev]' for backend. cd frontend && npm install for frontend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to PyPI, npm, Docker Hub. No running Docker daemon available for actual container builds but we can validate configs. PostgreSQL and Redis not running locally - tests mock them.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: FastAPI routers in src/api/routers/, services in src/api/services/, Pydantic models for request/response, SQLAlchemy async ORM, structlog for logging, pytest-asyncio for tests.
key_patterns: 1. Router pattern: APIRouter with tags, Depends for auth/db injection. 2. Auth: JWT bearer tokens via get_current_user, API keys via X-API-Key header. 3. Models: SQLAlchemy declarative base imported from src.api.models (User, APIKey, UsageLog). 4. Config: pydantic-settings BaseSettings with env vars. 5. Frontend: React Router pages in src/pages/, hooks in src/hooks/, Tailwind CSS. 6. Docker: multi-stage builds, alpine base images.
directory_structure: Root: src/api/ (FastAPI gateway), src/worker/ (model inference), src/shared/ (config/logging), frontend/ (React SPA), migrations/ (Alembic), tests/ (pytest), scripts/ (utilities), claude/ (docs). Models are referenced at src/api/models/ but physical files need to be created.
